items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, preserve the active measurement gates, and queue three bounded reversible actions for fishhooklabs.com, allthingsmasonic.com, and americastrikes.com. Evidence: the 30-day SEO window shows fishhooklabs.com at 138 impressions and position 9.3; Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. Site-level margin and ROI are not calculable because one tracking ID is unmapped and direct costs are unavailable. Main unknown: whether the proposed fixes improve qualified clicks or monetization without regression. Smallest next step: capture baselines, apply only reversible changes, and measure after 14 days or 100 new impressions. Owner decision: should we prepare an unsent Woot permission request, keep the gate unchanged, or stop pursuing public beta?
